posts.error: held: the Nepali editor's final reading still found a fact wrong

posts.text:
नेपाली कांग्रेस अहिले दुई पक्षमा बाँडिएको छ, र दुई महिनाको फरकमा दुईवटा महाधिवेशन हुँदै छन्। पूर्वप्रधानमन्त्री शेरबहादुर देउवाको समूह ५ अक्टोबरको मनोनयनमा सहभागी नभई डिसेम्बरमा हुने आफ्नै महाधिवेशनतिर लागेको छ।
सर्वोच्च अदालतले थापाको पक्षमा गरेको अप्रिलको फैसला अगस्टमा पुनरावलोकन गर्ने निर्णय गरेको काठमाडौं पोस्टले जनाएको छ। मनोनयन भने त्यही पुनरावलोकनको टुंगो नलाग्दै अघि बढिरहेको छ।

Nepal Wire's take: Four outlets reported today's nomination date, and all four missed that Nepali Congress is now split between two rival camps holding two separate conventions. Sher Bahadur Deuba, the former prime minister, has told members to skip the October convention entirely, calling it the product of an "illegal special convention." His camp is building its own convention for December. The Supreme Court agreed in August to review its April ruling that backed Gagan Thapa, now party president, Kathmandu Post reported. Readers deserve to know which camp they are actually reading about.

────────────────────────

Nepali Congress sets October 5 nominations as Deuba urges boycott

Deuba's camp plans its own December convention, and the Supreme Court agreed in August to review its April ruling backing Thapa, Kathmandu Post reported.
